title: Commercial Tenant Credit Risk

blueprintSignals.name: Payment days trend
blueprintSignals.definition: change in average days paid after the due date over the last 6 months
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Agreed concessions look like lateness, so exclude them

blueprintSignals.name: Rent to revenue
blueprintSignals.definition: annual rent divided by estimated annual tenant revenue
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Revenue estimates are noisy, so use sector medians when private

blueprintSignals.name: Sector stress index
blueprintSignals.definition: composite of insolvencies, footfall and sector sales for the tenant's industry
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Different sources give different readings, so use one

blueprintSignals.name: Guarantor strength
blueprintSignals.definition: credit rating or equivalent of the parent or guarantor
blueprintSignals.asOfRule: Ratings are missing for private guarantors, so mark them unknown

label: For "Commercial Tenant Credit Risk": Predict the likelihood that commercial tenants default on rent so landlords price deposits, incentives and exposure. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Few defaults make any estimate noisy and hide poor performance on the rare cases.
